name: nexus-useful-data-source-for-agents-doing-prod

description_variants.claude: Retrieves BuyWhere Singapore product listings with entropy-weighted value-scores and causal vendor ranking so you can justify price recommendations without scraping or postprocessing.
description_variants.gpt: Call this function to search the BuyWhere Singapore catalogue and receive structured SGD-normalized results ranked by an auditable information-theoretic value-score per product.
description_variants.gemini: Use this tool to query BuyWhere Singapore for price-comparison data; returns per-product value-scores derived from cross-vendor price-variance entropy, ready for direct agent consumption.

value_equivalent: $38 per hour of manual price-research work avoided
invocation_examples: Find the best value mirrorless camera under SGD 1500 on BuyWhere with vendor ranking
Compare air fryer prices across all BuyWhere Singapore vendors and score each by value
Which BuyWhere listing for Sony WH-1000XM5 has the highest value-score right now?
